title: macOSLAPS (com.joshua-d-miller.macoslaps)
description: macOSLAPS 4.x settings. Upload as a Jamf Pro Application & Custom Settings schema for the preference domain com.joshua-d-miller.macoslaps. Unset keys use the built-in defaults.

LocalAdminAccount.title: Local admin account
LocalAdminAccount.description: Short name of the local admin account macOSLAPS manages.

Method.title: Method
Method.description: Local stores the password in the System keychain for your MDM to collect with -escrow. AD writes it to the computer object in Active Directory.

FirstPass.title: First password
FirstPass.description: The account's current password, used once for the first rotation (needed for an account with a secureToken). Never printed by -showConfig.

ADSchema.title: Active Directory schema
ADSchema.description: legacy: ms-Mcs-AdmPwd. windowsLAPS: msLAPS-Password (ADUC LAPS tab, Get-LapsADPassword). both: write both. windowsLAPS and both are experimental.

PreferredDC.title: Preferred domain controller
PreferredDC.description: Domain controller to use with Method AD.

PasswordStyle.title: Password style
PasswordStyle.description: random, or readable (letters and digits without look-alikes, grouped by 4, for reading over the phone). passphrase falls back to readable for now.

PasswordGrouping.title: Group size
PasswordGrouping.description: Insert a separator every N characters (0: none).

RemovePassChars.title: Characters to exclude
RemovePassChars.description: Characters never used in a password.

ExclusionSets.title: Excluded character sets
ExclusionSets.description: Whole sets never used in a password.

PasswordRequirements.title: Minimum characters of each kind
PasswordRequirements.description: Every password has at least this many of each kind.

RemoveKeychain.title: Remove the admin's login keychain
RemoveKeychain.description: Delete the admin's login keychain after a rotation, since it would still use the old password.

EscrowCertificates.title: Escrow certificates
EscrowCertificates.description: RSA certificates (PEM text or base64 DER, one per item). -escrow encrypts its output to them with CMS (AES-256). If set but none is usable, -escrow prints no password.

StagedRotation.title: Staged rotation
StagedRotation.description: auto: stage the next password when -escrow ran on this Mac in the last 14 days. on: always. off: rotate immediately.

EscrowConfirmations.title: Exports before a staged password is used
EscrowConfirmations.description: -escrow exports needed before a staged password is applied.

InventoryHook.title: Inventory hook
InventoryHook.description: jamf runs jamf recon after a rotation; custom runs InventoryHookCommand.

InventoryHookCommand.title: Custom inventory command
InventoryHookCommand.description: The program and its arguments, one per item.

InventoryHookConfirms.title: Custom hook confirms collection
InventoryHookConfirms.description: True if the custom command collects inventory, so it confirms a staged password.

ApprovedAdmins.title: Approved admins
ApprovedAdmins.description: Accounts allowed to stay in the admin group besides the managed admin and root: short names, or group:<name> for a group's members.

AdminGroupPolicy.title: Admin group policy
AdminGroupPolicy.description: auto: remove unapproved admins unless an elevation tool is installed (then report only). report: only list them. enforce: remove them even with an elevation tool.

RetrievalMode.title: Retrieval mode
RetrievalMode.description: escrow: the MDM collects the password (-escrow). device: the MDM collects a reveal code and the password is revealed on the Mac.

RevealGracePeriod.title: Grace period after a reveal (hours)
RevealGracePeriod.description: Device mode: hours the revealed password keeps working before it rotates (0: no rotation after a reveal).

RevealAction.title: At the end of the grace period
RevealAction.description: rotateAndLogout logs the admin out first if it has a session; rotate only rotates.

ADRevealCode.title: Write the reveal code to AD
ADRevealCode.description: Device mode with Method AD: store the reveal code in Active Directory instead of the password.
